title: Where would you like to begin?
lede: Three short questions, a minute at most. Nothing is saved or sent: it simply points you to the right place, and you can keep what calls to you.
q1Hint: Hover or tap to see each one’s world; choose the one that feels truest.

wants.devotion: A deeper bond with Kali, the Devi or the unseen
wants.magic: To change something: protection, love, abundance, a curse lifted
wants.healing: To heal, let go and feel lighter
wants.identity: To feel at home in my body, my identity and my relationships
wants.learning: To learn the craft and practise it myself

q2Hint: Each holds a few kinds of work; you will see some of them next.
q3: How would you like to begin?

resultText.talk: A first conversation is unhurried: you say as much or as little as you like, and together you find what would help. Keep anything below that calls to you, and it goes with your request.
resultText.session: Keep the kinds of work that call to you, and ask about them; Sarvakali will reply with a time, or suggest another way in.
resultText.self: Begin on your own with the practice below. When you are ready, the services you kept go with your request.
resultText.learn: Classes and mentoring are in Learning; the class finder there points you to where to start. Keep anything here you would like to learn about.

suggest: A few of the kinds of work here
keepHint: Tap to keep; your list follows you round the site and goes with your request.
share: Copy a link to this path
care: Some of this work touches the mind and the body. It is spiritual work, not a replacement for medical or psychological care, and it goes at your pace. If you are struggling, please also reach out to a doctor or counsellor; in India, Tele-MANAS is free on 14416, day and night.
